It must preserve WP0 v1.4 tests, all other suite/version selection, child nonzero/timeout/error propagation, and the existing positive test-count requirement. It must not repurpose the WP14 moving-tree verifier or silently turn a direct package validate result into approval.

Direct verification/wp0/v1.4.0/tools/verify.mjs --validate and --issue must remain strict and unchanged in meaning. Missing, stale, wrong-package, wrong-scope, tampered, or mismatched-subject approvals must fail or remain pending; the new CI technical draft must remain pending_authorized_review with release_gate_pass=false.
implementation_conditions.required_current_binding: PR-082 must require an approval/evidence pair whose subject_sha256 exactly equals the fresh current draft subject; the historical 0098ee... approval cannot satisfy this condition.

implementation_conditions.condition: Historical WP0 v1.4 approval.json, evidence.txt, approved.json, predecessor receipts, and implementation inventory must be pinned by exact bytes/digests and never overwritten or repinned by the current-CI route. Tests must exercise altered historical bytes as failures.
